description:
This is a semantic migration, carried out while Sphinx is still the oracle. The scope is the .rst files in docs/ that do not contain autodoc directives: 53 .rst total minus the 27 autodoc files, which astro-site-34 handles.

Preserve everything the RST carries:
- toctree navigation (39 toctrees across all .rst) and :doc: references (236 across docs/)
- labels and anchors, tables (list-table, csv-table), captions, sphinx_design blocks, tag pages

Each output keeps its URL: same stem, same .html. Use MyST forms the Astro converter supports, preferring plain Markdown.

The existing Sphinx -W build, spellcheck and public-site visual acceptance must stay green, so this ships value even if the migration stops. Splitting into several PRs by docs section is fine.
